plan.notes: Official UW-Madison Guide 2026-2027 Traditional BSN. A total of 124 credits are required; nursing core is 57 credits as published. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence (students enter as pre-nursing and apply mid-sophomore year), so this is recorded as requirements_only. Choice slots recorded at minimum credit per convention: CHEM 103 (4) over 108/109 (5 each); MICROBIO 101 (3) over CHEM 343 (3)/NUTR SCI 332; ANAT&PHY 235 (4) over 335 (5); PSYCH 202 (3, listed 3-4); HDFS 262 (3). MATH 112 College Algebra (3) required under Math. Prerequisite credits verified on guide.wisc.edu course pages. General degree requirement blocks (Humanities 6, Humanities-or-Social-Science 7, Comm A/B, QR A/B, Ethnic Studies) per the published table; 16 credits of general/nursing electives bring the published total to exactly 124 (the program notes electives in general education and nursing). Electives recorded at 13 credits: 26 (prereq block at minimums) + 28 (general degree blocks) + 57 (nursing core) = 111; 124 - 111 = 13.
